==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
Using the self induced sleep paralysis method, I attained lucidity. I quickly flew over the open ocean.

I created glaciers with ice breath and used them for target practice.

I tested sonic screams, laser vision, X-ray vision, and super strength on these glaciers.
